concepts.name: Health, hygiene and the spread of disease
concepts.description: A healthy person (physical, mental and social well-being); personal and food hygiene; disposing of litter and waste by burying, recycling and burning; how diseases spread through water (cholera), food, contact (Ebola) and vectors (malaria, bilharzia).

concepts.name: Ebola virus disease
concepts.description: Ebola virus disease: its cause (the Ebola virus), spread by direct contact with the blood and body fluids of infected people, living or dead, and of infected animals; its signs and symptoms; supportive treatment; and prevention by isolation, protective clothing, safe burials, hand-washing and vaccination.

concepts.name: Processing groundnuts: peanut butter and peanut oil
concepts.description: Value addition to groundnuts: the processes of shelling, roasting, grinding and packaging peanut butter and the equipment used (sheller, roaster, peanut butter making machine, grinding stone and mortar and pestle); pressing peanut butter to separate oil, and the uses of the oil.

concepts.name: Siphons, hydraulic systems and pumps
concepts.description: The siphon; hydraulic systems (the hydraulic jack and car braking system); the lift pump (the Blair pump) and the force pump (the bicycle pump), explained using atmospheric and fluid pressure.

concepts.name: Gears
concepts.description: Gears as simple machines: driver and driven gears, the velocity ratio from the numbers of teeth, changing speed, turning force and direction; gear trains; gears in bicycles, hand drills, egg beaters and vehicle gearboxes.

concepts.name: Solar cookers and solar water heaters
concepts.description: Qualitative design and function of box and reflector (curved) solar cookers and of solar water heaters: absorbing radiation with black surfaces, reflecting it with shiny curved surfaces, reducing losses by insulation and glazing, and convection in thermosiphon heaters.

concepts.name: Telecommunication
concepts.description: Communicating over a distance by cell phone and email: transmitters, receivers, encoding and decoding, energy conversions; transmission media (sheathed twisted-pair cables, coaxial cables, optical fibres and Wi-Fi radio links) and their advantages.
